mapper.sql: m.id, m.metric_code, m.occurred_at, m.record_date, m.unit_code, m.scene_code, m.numeric_value, m.secondary_value, m.detail_json, m.note, m.report_id, m.actor_user_id, m.request_id, m.request_hash, m.version, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, m.del_flag
mapper.select: select from preg_measurement m where m.id = #{id} and m.del_flag = '0'
select from preg_measurement m where m.actor_user_id = #{actorUserId} and m.request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into preg_measurement ( metric_code, occurred_at, record_date, unit_code, scene_code, numeric_value, secondary_value, detail_json, note, report_id, actor_user_id, request_id, request_hash, version, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{metricCode}, #{occurredAt}, #{recordDate}, #{unitCode}, #{sceneCode}, #{numericValue}, #{secondaryValue}, #{detailJson}, #{note}, #{reportId}, #{actorUserId}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, 1, #{createBy}, now(3) )
mapper.update: update preg_measurement set occurred_at = #{occurredAt}, record_date = #{recordDate}, unit_code = #{unitCode}, scene_code = #{sceneCode}, numeric_value = #{numericValue}, secondary_value = #{secondaryValue}, detail_json = #{detailJson}, note = #{note}, report_id = #{reportId}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
update preg_measurement set del_flag = '2', version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now(3) where id = #{id} and version = #{version} and del_flag = '0'
update preg_measurement set report_id = null, update_time = now(3) where report_id = #{reportId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select sum(m.numeric_value) from preg_measurement m where m.metric_code = 'water' and m.record_date = #{recordDate} and m.del_flag = '0'
select from preg_measurement m where m.report_id = #{reportId} and m.del_flag = '0' order by m.occurred_at asc, m.id asc
select exists( select 1 from preg_measurement m where m.record_date = #{recordDate} and m.del_flag = '0' )
